detectionTools.description: Scans import graph to identify unused exports
Checks file content for emptiness, comment ratio, re-export ratio
Checks test files for minimum case count and assertion density
Checks for artificial fragmentation across modules

antiGamingRules.description: Files with <50 bytes of non-whitespace content are flagged as gaming
Files where >90% of content is comments are flagged
Files that only re-export from other modules are not meaningful source files
Exports not used by any consumer within the product are NOT counted
Endpoints without behavior tests are flagged as suspicious
Test files with <3 test cases or 0 assertions are flagged
Modules with 0 meaningful exports are flagged
Splitting a coherent module into many single-export files to increase file count is flagged
Adding barrel re-exports solely to increase export count is flagged
Factory governance files, verifier scripts, handoff capsules are NOT product complexity
File/export counts are diagnostic indicators, NOT product quality proof

meaningfulDefinitions.meaningfulTest: Test case exercising non-trivial product behavior with assertions
meaningfulDefinitions.meaningfulEndpoint: HTTP endpoint with >=1 passing behavior test
meaningfulDefinitions.equivalentTestGroup: A test file covering a distinct subsystem with >=3 test cases and >=1 assertion each
meaningfulDefinitions.meaningfulSourceFile: >=50 bytes non-whitespace, >=1 non-trivial export serving a distinct architectural purpose
meaningfulDefinitions.meaningfulExport: const/function/class/type/interface/enum used by >=1 consumer within the product
meaningfulDefinitions.equivalentBehavior: An action/endpoint/feature that is independently verifiable and serves a distinct user/business purpose
